children.name: Text
children.text:
Fixed 56 header on the
background, never
scrolls. ONE card with
an 8 margin fills the
rest and is never
taller; content
scrolls inside the
card, the document
never does. React:
AppShell. Compose:
HfpsScaffold(topBar).

note.text: Fixed 56 header on the background, never scrolls. ONE card with an 8 margin fills the rest and is never taller; content scrolls inside the card, the document never does. React: AppShell. Compose: HfpsScaffold(topBar).

children.name: Text
children.text:
From 768: the sidebar
sits on the background
next to the card
(Sidebar
variant="inset"), the
card keeps its inset
margin. Same rule:
header fixed, scroll
inside the card.
React: AppShell +
SidebarInset.

note.text: From 768: the sidebar sits on the background next to the card (Sidebar variant="inset"), the card keeps its inset margin. Same rule: header fixed, scroll inside the card. React: AppShell + SidebarInset.

children.name: Text
children.text:
Title or logo left,
actions right (theme
menu, status). Menu on
phones with a sidebar,
back on sub-pages. No
bottom border. React:
AppShell header.
Compose:
HfpsTopBar(title,
onBack, actions).

note.text: Title or logo left, actions right (theme menu, status). Menu on phones with a sidebar, back on sub-pages. No bottom border. React: AppShell header. Compose: HfpsTopBar(title, onBack, actions).

children.name: Text
children.text:
From 768 the menu
button goes (the
sidebar is shown);
same 56 bar. React:
AppShell header.

note.text: From 768 the menu button goes (the sidebar is shown); same 56 bar. React: AppShell header.

children.name: Text
children.text:
Opened from the
header's theme icon:
one dropdown, two
radio groups, Theme
then Palette. Saved
per browser. React:
ThemeMenu
(DropdownMenuRadioGrou
p).

note.text: Opened from the header's theme icon: one dropdown, two radio groups, Theme then Palette. Saved per browser. React: ThemeMenu (DropdownMenuRadioGroup).

children.name: Text
children.text:
Desktop navigation, on
the background beside
the card; a
full-height Sheet from
the menu button on
phones. Section labels
are eyebrows. React:
Sidebar
variant="inset".

note.text: Desktop navigation, on the background beside the card; a full-height Sheet from the menu button on phones. Section labels are eyebrows. React: Sidebar variant="inset".

children.name: Text
children.text:
Below 768 the
breadcrumb trail
collapses to one "←
Parent" link in the
header. Back goes to
the parent level, not
back in history.
React: Page
breadcrumbs
(md:hidden).

note.text: Below 768 the breadcrumb trail collapses to one "← Parent" link in the header. Back goes to the parent level, not back in history. React: Page breadcrumbs (md:hidden).

children.name: Text
children.text:
2 or 3 sections: plain
tabs fit a phone.
Never a horizontally
scrolling tab strip.
React: Tabs.

note.text: 2 or 3 sections: plain tabs fit a phone. Never a horizontally scrolling tab strip. React: Tabs.

children.name: Text
children.text:
4 or more sections: a
full-width select
below @2xl, the tabs
from @2xl up; same
value, same
navigation. React:
SectionSwitcher.

note.text: 4 or more sections: a full-width select below @2xl, the tabs from @2xl up; same value, same navigation. React: SectionSwitcher.

children.name: Text
children.text:
Every page below the
top level has a trail;
the last crumb is the
current page, not a
link. Title row with a
ghost back button to
the parent. React:
Page breadcrumbs +
breadcrumbs.ts.

note.text: Every page below the top level has a trail; the last crumb is the current page, not a link. Title row with a ghost back button to the parent. React: Page breadcrumbs + breadcrumbs.ts.

children.name: Text
children.text:
The only uppercase
text: 12 medium,
tracked 0.08em, for
section labels only.
Never on a control,
tab or table header.
React: eyebrow
utility. Compose:
Eyebrow(text).

note.text: The only uppercase text: 12 medium, tracked 0.08em, for section labels only. Never on a control, tab or table header. React: eyebrow utility. Compose: Eyebrow(text).

children.name: Text
children.text:
Settings-like row
inside the card, 56
tall in the kit (two
lines: name 15 + mono
meta 13), whole row
tappable, hairline
between rows. React:
card list row.
Compose: HfpsListRow +
HfpsRowDivider.

note.text: Settings-like row inside the card, 56 tall in the kit (two lines: name 15 + mono meta 13), whole row tappable, hairline between rows. React: card list row. Compose: HfpsListRow + HfpsRowDivider.

children.name: Text
children.text:
Single choice: radio
rows, whole row
tappable, 48 min.
Compose: HfpsChoiceRow
in a
selectableGroup().

note.text: Single choice: radio rows, whole row tappable, 48 min. Compose: HfpsChoiceRow in a selectableGroup().

children.name: Text
children.text:
Several choices: check
rows, whole row
toggles, 48 min.
Compose: HfpsCheckRow.

note.text: Several choices: check rows, whole row toggles, 48 min. Compose: HfpsCheckRow.

children.name: Text
children.text:
Label and value on one
row, 48 min; drag
anywhere on the row,
tap the value to type
it. Compose:
HfpsSlider.

note.text: Label and value on one row, 48 min; drag anywhere on the row, tap the value to type it. Compose: HfpsSlider.

children.name: Text
children.text:
ONE primary action per
screen or sheet. 44
min height, sentence
case. React: Button.
Compose:
PrimaryButton.

note.text: ONE primary action per screen or sheet. 44 min height, sentence case. React: Button. Compose: PrimaryButton.

children.name: Text
children.text:
Neutral, hairline
border. React: Button
variant="outline".
Compose:
SecondaryButton.

note.text: Neutral, hairline border. React: Button variant="outline". Compose: SecondaryButton.

children.name: Text
children.text:
Cancel, Reset. React:
Button
variant="ghost".
Compose: GhostButton.

note.text: Cancel, Reset. React: Button variant="ghost". Compose: GhostButton.

children.name: Text
children.text:
Every icon-only
action: 24 icon in a
48 touch target (36
h-9 in web toolbars),
with a tooltip and a
label for screen
readers. React: Button
size="icon". Compose:
HfpsIconButton.

note.text: Every icon-only action: 24 icon in a 48 touch target (36 h-9 in web toolbars), with a tooltip and a label for screen readers. React: Button size="icon". Compose: HfpsIconButton.

children.name: Text
children.text:
Filters and segments
in a row: 36 visible,
48 target, selected =
filled. Compose:
HfpsChip. Web:
ToggleGroup from @2xl,
a Select below.

note.text: Filters and segments in a row: 36 visible, 48 target, selected = filled. Compose: HfpsChip. Web: ToggleGroup from @2xl, a Select below.

children.name: Text
children.text:
Below @md the search
takes its own
full-width row; the
filter becomes a
select. Controls 36,
gap 8.

note.text: Below @md the search takes its own full-width row; the filter becomes a select. Controls 36, gap 8.

children.name: Text
children.text:
Two columns on phones,
never an orphan row.
Eyebrow label over a
20–24 semibold tabular
number.

note.text: Two columns on phones, never an orphan row. Eyebrow label over a 20–24 semibold tabular number.

children.name: Text
children.text:
Search, filter, sort
on one row that never
wraps; search shrinks
first. Controls 36
(h-9), never mixed
with sm. Sticky at the
top of the card.

note.text: Search, filter, sort on one row that never wraps; search shrinks first. Controls 36 (h-9), never mixed with sm. Sticky at the top of the card.

children.name: Text
children.text:
Up to 4 metrics, py-4,
borders between them
(not fills). Headline
numbers large, labels
small. React:
grid-cols-2
md:grid-cols-[repeat(4
,…)].

note.text: Up to 4 metrics, py-4, borders between them (not fills). Headline numbers large, labels small. React: grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-[repeat(4,…)].

children.name: Text
children.text:
One summary metric:
eyebrow label, number
with tabular-nums.
Values change without
animating.

note.text: One summary metric: eyebrow label, number with tabular-nums. Values change without animating.

children.name: Text
children.text:
Below @xl (~576) a
table renders as a
card list: same data,
search, filters and
selection; no column
header. Row actions go
behind a ⋯ icon
button. React:
DataList (cards).

note.text: Below @xl (~576) a table renders as a card list: same data, search, filters and selection; no column header. Row actions go behind a ⋯ icon button. React: DataList (cards).

children.name: Text
children.text:
An empty list says
what goes there and
offers the one action.
Never a "select an
item" placeholder.
React: Empty.

note.text: An empty list says what goes there and offers the one action. Never a "select an item" placeholder. React: Empty.

children.name: Text
children.text:
From @xl: table-fixed,
a flexible primary
column, fixed widths
on the others; header
muted, no fill.
Selected row =
background only, never
a left bar. React:
DataList (table).

note.text: From @xl: table-fixed, a flexible primary column, fixed widths on the others; header muted, no fill. Selected row = background only, never a left bar. React: DataList (table).

children.name: Text
children.text:
Master-detail: the
list takes the full
width until something
is selected. No detail
panel and no
placeholder before
that. Insert hfps ·
Toolbar and hfps ·
Data table in the
card.

note.text: Master-detail: the list takes the full width until something is selected. No detail panel and no placeholder before that. Insert hfps · Toolbar and hfps · Data table in the card.

children.name: Text
children.text:
Selected: the detail
panel opens beside the
list (~60/40,
resizable); the list
keeps its tree
position so search,
filter and sort
survive. Below 1024
the detail is a
full-screen sheet.
React:
ResizablePanelGroup.

note.text: Selected: the detail panel opens beside the list (~60/40, resizable); the list keeps its tree position so search, filter and sort survive. Below 1024 the detail is a full-screen sheet. React: ResizablePanelGroup.

children.name: Text
children.text:
Detail and editor
sheets take the full
screen on phones: no
max width, no strip of
the page behind; close
with the X, no swipe.
React: Sheet (full
width below 1024).

note.text: Detail and editor sheets take the full screen on phones: no max width, no strip of the page behind; close with the X, no swipe. React: Sheet (full width below 1024).

children.name: Text
children.text:
Form dialogs on
phones: a bottom
drawer with a grab
handle (it drags), up
to ~92dvh, header
fixed, body scrolls,
full-width buttons at
least 44, primary
first then Cancel.
React:
ResponsiveDialog.
Compose:
HfpsBottomSheet.

note.text: Form dialogs on phones: a bottom drawer with a grab handle (it drags), up to ~92dvh, header fixed, body scrolls, full-width buttons at least 44, primary first then Cancel. React: ResponsiveDialog. Compose: HfpsBottomSheet.

children.name: Text
children.text:
From 768 (840dp on
Android) the same form
is a centred dialog;
call sites do not
change. React:
ResponsiveDialog.
Compose:
HfpsBottomSheet.

note.text: From 768 (840dp on Android) the same form is a centred dialog; call sites do not change. React: ResponsiveDialog. Compose: HfpsBottomSheet.

children.name: Text
children.text:
"Pick several, then
confirm": an All row,
one row per item (48
min, whole row
toggles), Cancel and
the confirm action,
disabled while nothing
is ticked. Compose:
HfpsChecklist in
HfpsBottomSheet.

note.text: "Pick several, then confirm": an All row, one row per item (48 min, whole row toggles), Cancel and the confirm action, disabled while nothing is ticked. Compose: HfpsChecklist in HfpsBottomSheet.

children.name: Text
children.text:
Short confirmations
stay a centred alert
dialog on every width,
capped at the screen
height. React:
AlertDialog.

note.text: Short confirmations stay a centred alert dialog on every width, capped at the screen height. React: AlertDialog.

children.name: Text
children.text:
Bottom centre, above
the safe area; swipe
to dismiss stays on.
React: Sonner Toaster.

note.text: Bottom centre, above the safe area; swipe to dismiss stays on. React: Sonner Toaster.

children.name: Text
children.text:
Phone settings from
the kit: top bar with
back, one card,
eyebrow sections, list
rows, a choice group,
a slider row, one
primary action. Shared
components carry one
text, so rows with
their own text are
library rows (or
detached instances).

note.text: Phone settings from the kit: top bar with back, one card, eyebrow sections, list rows, a choice group, a slider row, one primary action. Shared components carry one text, so rows with their own text are library rows (or detached instances).

children.name: Text
children.text:
Desktop list + detail
from the kit: shell
with sidebar,
breadcrumbs, summary
strip, toolbar, data
table and the detail
panel of the selected
row, all inside the
one card.

note.text: Desktop list + detail from the kit: shell with sidebar, breadcrumbs, summary strip, toolbar, data table and the detail panel of the selected row, all inside the one card.
